entities.summary: Sharon Bezaly (b. 1972-10-02, Tel Aviv) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tel Aviv and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
